تستمعي (form VIII)
# تَسْتَمِعِي (tastamiʕī) /tas.ta.mi.ʕiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَمَعَ (istamaʕa)
# تُسْتَمَعِي (tustamaʕī) /tus.ta.ma.ʕiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَمَعَ (istamaʕa)
